name: pmg-set-success-metrics
description: Sets the success metrics for one release as a HEART table that runs from goals to signals to metrics, with a baseline, a target and a guardrail for each. Use for "run pmg-set-success-metrics", "success metrics for this release", "HEART metrics", "goals signals metrics", "how do we know if it worked", "define success before launch", "feature adoption metric", "release KPIs", part of The Complete Claude Guide for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
